name: Varen
description: Original adult Viltrumite protagonist. Compact strong simplified adult body, total height and compact body proportions exactly as the attached inspected identity. Smooth round PURE WHITE head, black dot eyes, tiny line mouth, no hair, moustache, beard, nose, ears, brows or face markings. Pale GREY fitted long-sleeve superhero bodysuit, dark RED high collar, RED waist belt and RED calf boots, dark grey wrist cuffs with exposed WHITE mitten hands. No cape, helmet, shoulder armour, weapon, face tattoo or borrowed Omni-Man/Mark design. Full-body neutral standing pose.

name: Varen
description: Same ONE compact adult Varen, OVERSIZED white round head/white mitten hands, grey covered suit/RED collar belt boots/black cuffs. ONE small frayed RIGHT shoulder sleeve tear exposing pure WHITE skin; no blood/red wound, all pants/thighs intact, no extra tear.

references.inspection: Actually viewed: one compact sturdy adult Varen with oversized round white head, grey covered uniform/red collar/belt/boots, white mitten hands, ONE pure-white frayed RIGHT shoulder patch and intact pants. No red wound/extra tears.

name: Rusk
description: Distinct adult imperial commander. Same compact white round-head cartoon, WHITE mitten hands, no hair/beard/nose/ears. CHARCOAL long-sleeve high-neck military tunic and matching long trousers, muted GOLD collar stripe and GOLD waist belt, BLACK boots. Broad simple shoulders. No red hero belt or cape, no helmet. Full-body neutral standing pose.

name: Talen
description: Distinct adult Viltrumite peer. Same compact white circular head and white mitten hands, black dot eyes/tiny line mouth, no hair/ears/markings. Pale GREY long-sleeve fitted suit, a diagonal muted BLUE sash across the chest and BLUE waist belt, DARK GREY boots. No red hero trim, cape or weapons. Full-body neutral standing pose.

name: Mira
description: Distinct adult human engineer. Same compact white circular head, WHITE mitten hands, tiny black dot eyes/line mouth, no nose/hair/ears or brows. Mustard YELLOW long-sleeve work jacket, DARK NAVY trousers and BROWN ankle boots. Grey plain tool pouch secured at waist, no backpack, helmet or hero bodysuit. Full-body neutral standing pose.

name: Mira
description: Same ONE compact adult Mira, pure white round head/dot eyes/tiny mouth/white hands, NAVY long-sleeved undershirt/navy trousers/brown work boots/toolbelt. NO yellow jacket on body; folded yellow jacket is separate table prop.

references.inspection: Actually viewed: one adult Mira, larger white round head/shorter sturdy proportions, navy shirt/pants, brown boots/toolbelt, empty white hands, no yellow jacket or second person.

name: DockWorker

references.inspection: Actually viewed: one round-white adult, navy work clothes/orange reflective vest/yellow hardhat/dark boots, empty white hands, no second actor.

name: RescuedDriver
